title: The Deadline of Kowloon
author: Emrys Thornbury
blurb: Coral Joubert, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
